proposition: Muḥammad Pārsā (Naqshbandi, d. 822/1419) appears as one of two Sufi masters ranked with Ibn Turka and Yazdī by Dawlatshāh, and Ibn Turka dwells on Pārsā's orthodoxy in Nafsat I; the pages read report no personal relationship between them, and MK says the appeal to Pārsā should be taken with several grains of salt.

mediation.who: Ibn Turka, Nafsat al-Masdur I (829/1426, to Shahrukh's court)
mediation.note: written to the court that was judging him; MK: produced under duress, treat with caution (pdf p.32 fn 44)
